info.description:
GraphQL

The GraphQL API provides queries and mutations to the same resources stored on the Kibo platform as those of the REST API. A full listing of the queries and mutations can be retrieved from the GraphQL schema which can be obtained via introspection or via the Documentation Explorer in the GraphQL playground located in the root of your site /graphql or thru the Graphql Voyager located [yoursite]/graphql/voyager.

GraphQL Playground

To access the GraphQL Storefront API Playground and documentation view your sites web front end ( so that a cookie can be set ) and then navigate to /graphql.

Then clicke the settings gear in the upper right corner and set "request.credentials": "include"

From there you can make any storefront calls allowed by a shopper.

To make admistrative calls. Use a jwt token gotten from the application development oauth authenticate method.
